gaps.lead: He lost his job because he kept arriving late.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept arriving late, he ___ his job.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + participle.

gaps.lead: We took a spare tyre in case the journey went wrong.
gaps.sentence: We took a spare tyre ___ went wrong.
gaps.explanation: in case + clause = as a precaution because something might happen.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ that they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.answer: suggested having / suggested that they have
gaps.explanation: suggest + -ing (or suggest that + clause): suggested having.

gaps.answer: one who planted / person who planted
gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who planted' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.answer: the reason she was chosen / the reason why she was chosen
accept: the reason why she was chosen
gaps.lead: They chose her for the lead role because of her voice.
gaps.sentence: Her voice was ___ for the lead role.
gaps.explanation: the reason (why/that) + clause: the reason (why) she was chosen.
